pull.title: KAFKA-21251: Label global stores with their real sub-topology id in --describe --topology
pull.body:
Global stores share Streams' subtopology id counter, so the formatter
labels them with the lowest id not used by a subtopology instead of
starting at `subtopologies().size()`, which could collide.

review_comments.body: Now that the labels are right, the order still differs from `Topology#describe()`, which interleaves subtopologies and global stores by id (see `InternalTopologyBuilder.TopologyDescription#toString`). With a global store at 0 and subtopologies 1, 2, the app logs show the global store first, while here it comes last. It would be nice to match since the class javadoc says we mirror `describe()`.

This depends on `TopologyDescriptionConverter.toWire` sorting both lists and on the topology description plugin keeping that order. Neither the protocol nor `StreamsGroupTopologyDescriptionPlugin` guarantees it. Could we say it is an assumption and point to where the sort happens?

Longer term it would be more robust to carry the global store id in `TopologyDescriptionGlobalStore`, but since these RPCs shipped in 4.4.0 that needs new versions and a KIP, so not for this PR.

commit.message:
KAFKA-21251: Label global stores with their real sub-topology id in --describe --topology

TopologyDescriptionFormatter labelled global stores starting at
subtopologies().size(), assuming regular subtopologies are numbered
0..N-1. Kafka Streams assigns subtopology and global store ids from a
single contiguous counter, so when a global store is defined first it
gets id 0 and the regular subtopologies get 1..N, and the formatter's
global store label collided with a real subtopology id.

Since both lists are sent sorted by id, the global store ids are exactly
the ids not taken by a subtopology, in ascending order. Label each global
store with the lowest unused id, which matches stock
TopologyDescription#toString() output and can never collide.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Interleave global stores with subtopologies by id in topology output

- print subtopologies and global stores in ascending id order, matching
  Topology#describe()
- document that inferring global store ids relies on
  TopologyDescriptionConverter#toWire sorting both lists, which the
  protocol does not guarantee

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
